questions.stem: A business leader wants visibility into where work stands in a process, particularly for business processes that include manual user steps. Which capability should the organization adopt?

explanation.correct: Playbooks offer visibility into where you are in a process, particularly business processes with manual user steps, which sets them apart from flows. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The advantage the docs give flows over playbooks is lower data storage in the instance, not visibility into process progress.
Service Catalog is for customizing portals where customers request service and product offerings, not for tracking progress through a process.
Virtual Agent increases deflections through self-service in a messaging interface; it does not show where you are in a process.

questions.quote: Playbooks offer visibility into where you're at in a process, particularly business processes with manual user steps.

questions.stem: Which of the following are parameters that an onChange() client script must specify? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: An onChange() client script runs when a particular field value changes on the form. It must specify the parameters control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading, and isTemplate, so control and oldValue are correct. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/api-reference/scripts/client-scripts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: callback is a parameter of onCellEdit() client scripts, which run when the list editor changes a cell value. It is not an onChange() parameter.
current is a predefined global variable in server-side business rules, not an onChange() client script parameter.
Display is a business rule When option, not a client script parameter.

questions.quote: onChange() — runs when a particular field value changes on the form. The onChange() client script must specify these parameters.

questions.stem: Which TWO of the following are accessibility features of the ServiceNow user interface?

explanation.correct: The documentation lists the accessibility features as keyboard navigation, color and style settings, using a screen reader, and search methods. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/p_NavigationAndUIConfiguration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: History is one of the Next Experience menus (with Favorites and Workspaces) for navigating to and saving resources, not an accessibility feature.
Workspaces is one of the Next Experience navigation menus, not an accessibility feature.
Landing pages are a Next Experience element (one that ATF doesn't yet support), not an accessibility feature.

questions.quote: Accessibility features include keyboard navigation, color and style settings, using a screen reader, and search methods.

questions.stem: In Next Experience, which TWO of the following are menus you can use to navigate to and save important resources?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that you navigate to and save important resources with the Favorites, History, and Workspaces menus, so History and Workspaces are both Next Experience menus. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/next-experience-landing-page.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Global Search is a Unified Navigation tool for searching across the instance, not one of the Favorites, History, and Workspaces menus.
Onboarding is a section of the Next Experience landing page that helps you get acquainted with the Unified Navigation UI, not a navigation menu.
Useful features is a landing page section for exploring additional feature resources, not a navigation menu.

questions.quote: Navigate to and save important resources with the Favorites, History, and Workspaces menus.

questions.stem: Which of the following are parameters of an onChange() client script? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: An onChange() client script runs when a particular field value changes on the form. It must specify the parameters control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading and isTemplate. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/api-reference/scripts/client-scripts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: oldValues (plural) is a parameter of onCellEdit() client scripts, which run when the list editor changes a cell value. onChange() uses the singular oldValue.
All is a value of the client script UI Type field (the script runs in all UIs), not a function parameter.
sysIDs is a parameter of onCellEdit() client scripts, not onChange().

questions.quote: onChange() — runs when a particular field value changes on the form. The onChange() client script must specify these parameters.

questions.stem: Which of the following are valid data source types in ServiceNow import sets? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: The documented data source types are File, JDBC, LDAP, OIDC, REST (IntegrationHub) and Custom (Load by Script). File, LDAP and Custom (Load by Script) are therefore valid. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_CreateNewDataSource.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Excel is a supported import file format, not a data source type. Excel data is brought in through a File type data source.
XML is a supported import file format, not a data source type.
Custom (Parse by Script) is a supported import file format. Don't confuse it with the Custom (Load by Script) data source type.

questions.quote: Create a File type data source ... Create a JDBC type data source ... Create an LDAP type data source ... Create an OIDC type data source ... Create a REST (Integration Hub) type data source ... Create a Custom (Load by Script) type data source

questions.stem: Which of the following are predefined global variables available in a business rule script? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: The documentation lists current, previous, g_scratchpad, and gs as the predefined global variables used to reference the system in a business rule script. current, previous, and gs are among the options. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/business-rules-classic/c_BusinessRules.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: 'Same as' is an assignment operator in a business rule's Set field values action (it uses the value of another field). It is not a script variable.
Display is one of the business rule When options that determine when the rule runs. It is not a global variable.
onSubmit() is a client script type, not a predefined variable in server-side business rules.

questions.quote: Use the following predefined global variables to reference the system in a business rule script.

questions.stem: Which of the following tools can be run on any table that extends the Task table? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: The documentation lists tools that can be run on any table that extends Task: Approvals, Assignments, Service levels, Inactivity monitors, and Workflow Studio. Approvals, Assignments, and Workflow Studio are among them. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_TaskTable.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Field Types is a tab in the form designer field navigator that lists field types you can add to a form. It is not a tool for working tasks.
A related list is one of the items shown as a cell in the form designer layout. It is not one of the documented tools for tables that extend Task.
Fields is a tab in the form designer field navigator that lists existing fields you can add to a form. It is not a tool for working tasks.

questions.quote:
These tools can be run on any table which extends Task.

-   Approvals

    Approvals can be generated to a list of Approvers, either manually or automatically, according to Approval Rules. Approvals can be incorporated into workflows or can stand alone. For more information, see [Process approvals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ServiceNow/ServiceNowDocs/australia/markdown/build-workflows/c_ProcessApprovals.md).

    Approvals can be used on tables that do not extend Task.

-   Assignments

    Assignment rules can automatically assign tasks to users or groups, ensuring that the most appropriate team members handle the tasks. For more information, see [Defining Assignment Rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ServiceNow/ServiceNowDocs/australia/markdown/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_DefineAssignmentRules.md).

-   Service levels

    Service level agreements can track the amount of time that a task has been open, to ensure that tasks are completed within an allotted time.

-   Inactivity monitors

    Inactivity monitors ensure that tasks do not fall by the wayside by notifying users when tasks have been untouched for a predefined period of time. For more information, see [Set an inactivity monitor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ServiceNow/ServiceNowDocs/australia/markdown/australia/platform-administration/time-configuration/t_SetAnInactivityMonitor.md).

-   Workflow Studio

    A process owner can design a flow for tasks that meet certain conditions. After a task is created that meets the conditions, the flow applies an automated process to the task.

questions.stem: An ACL is considered empty when it lacks certain components. Which of the following are among those components? (Choose 3.)

explanation.correct: The documentation defines empty ACLs as ACLs without one or more of these components: a defined role, a security attribute, a data condition, and a script. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The object being secured is something every ACL specifies. It is not one of the components (role, security attribute, data condition, script) whose absence makes an ACL empty.
Create is an operation that has default wild-card table (*) ACLs, not a component whose absence makes an ACL empty.
Write is an operation that has default wild-card table (*) ACLs, not a component whose absence makes an ACL empty.

questions.quote:
Empty ACLs are defined as ACLs without one or more of these components:

-   Defined role
-   Security attribute
-   Data condition
-   Script

questions.stem: Which actions can an administrator configure in a business rule without writing a script? (Choose 3.)

explanation.correct: The documentation states that administrators can set field values, create information messages, and abort transactions without writing a script. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/business-rules-classic/c_BusinessRules.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: previous is a predefined global variable used to reference the system inside a business rule script, so it is a scripting element, not a no-script action.
Before is a When option that sets when the business rule runs, not an action the rule performs.
Insert is a record operation that triggers a business rule, not an action the rule performs.

questions.quote: Administrators can set field values, create information messages, and abort transactions without writing a script.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes Adoption Services in ServiceNow?

options.text: Proactive AI assistant giving real-time voice and text step-by-step guidance
Defines the elements that appear when a user opens a form or list
Suite of solutions providing user support at the anticipated time of need
Set by user action; manual record changes don't affect the user

explanation.correct: Adoption Services is a suite of solutions, both products and features, that provide user support and critical information at the anticipated time of need. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/adoption-services.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes Dynamic Guidance, a proactive AI assistant, rather than the Adoption Services suite as a whole.
This describes a view, which defines the elements that appear when a user opens a form or list.
This describes a User Only user preference record, whose value is set by user action.

questions.quote: Adoption Services is a suite of solutions, both products and features, that provide user support and critical information at the anticipated time of need.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes the Configurable Workspace UI?

options.text: Set and updated by the system; administrators should not modify
Shows you where you are while you're working
Suite of tools in a single focused work area to resolve issues
Lets you access content across your instance in a single pane

explanation.correct: The Configurable Workspace UI brings a suite of tools into a single, focused work area so agents can answer customer questions and resolve issues. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/workspace-landing-page.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes a System Only user preference record, whose value the system sets and administrators should not modify.
This describes contextual navigation, which shows you where you are while you work, not a workspace.
This describes Unified Navigation, which gives access to content across the instance in a single pane.

questions.quote: The Configurable Workspace UI provides a suite of tools in a single, focused work area to help you answer customer questions and resolve issues.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes the Deny-Unless ACL decision type?

options.text: Controls which fields are saved when a template is created
Explicitly denies access unless conditions are passed
Allows access to resource if conditions are passed
Controls defining relationships between Configuration Item tables

explanation.correct: Deny-Unless restricts access to a resource by explicitly denying access unless the conditions pass. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes the save_as_template ACL operation, which controls which fields are saved when a template is created.
This describes the Allow-If decision type, which allows access if the conditions pass. Deny-Unless explicitly denies access instead.
This describes the edit_ci_relations ACL operation, not a decision type.

questions.quote: Restrict access to resource by explicitly denying access unless conditions are passed.

questions.stem: Which definition describes a foreign record insert?

options.text: Conversion of import set table data to another table via a transform map
An import change to a table that is not the import's target table
A view of different parts of the database schema
Determines whether an ACL applies to specific records

explanation.correct: A foreign record insert happens when an import changes a table that is not the import's target table. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportSetsKeyConcepts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This defines transformation: converting data from an import set table to another table according to the rules in a transform map.
This describes a schema map, which you generate to view parts of the database schema. It has nothing to do with imports.
This describes the ACL Applies-to field, which is an access control concept and not part of importing data.

questions.quote: A foreign record insert occurs when an import makes a change to a table that is not the target table for that import.

questions.stem: In the context of import sets, which definition matches the term transformation?

options.text: Conversion of import set table data to another table via a transform map
Import data from various data sources and map it into ServiceNow tables
Separates transform and processing functions; flexible alternative to transform maps
Lets a transform update existing target records instead of inserting new ones

explanation.correct: Transformation is the conversion of data from an import set table to another table according to the rules defined in a transform map. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportSetsKeyConcepts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes import sets as a whole: importing data from various data sources and mapping it into ServiceNow tables.
This describes the robust import set transformer, which separates the transform and processing functions as a more flexible alternative to transform maps.
This describes coalesce, which lets a transform update existing target table records instead of inserting new ones.

questions.quote: The conversion of data from an import set table to another table according to the rules defined in a transform map.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes a client script in ServiceNow?

options.text: JavaScript that runs in the web browser when client-based events occur
Stored JavaScript that runs on the server
Script that runs on the server or database
Single catalog request that can generate several ordered items

explanation.correct: Client scripts run JavaScript on the client (the web browser) when client-based events occur. Examples are when a form loads, after form submission, or when a field changes value. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/api-reference/scripts/client-scripts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes script includes, which store JavaScript that runs on the server, not in the browser.
This describes server scripts, which run on the server or database rather than on the client.
This describes a service catalog order guide, which lets a customer make a single request that generates several ordered items. It is not a script type.

questions.quote: Client scripts allow the system to run JavaScript on the client (web browser) when client-based events occur, such as when a form loads, after form submission, or when a field changes value.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes AI Data Explorer?

options.text: Constructs a condition statement from contextually generated fields
AI companion for instant insights and deep data explorations
Status information about individual import operations
Turns list and form navigation into an interactive graphical experience

explanation.correct: AI Data Explorer is described as your AI companion for instant insights and deep data explorations. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/ai-data-explorer.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes the condition builder, which constructs a condition statement from contextually generated fields.
This describes import run history, which gives status information about individual import operations.
This describes Visual Task Boards (VTB), which turn list and form navigation into an interactive graphical experience.

questions.quote: AI Data Explorer is your AI-companion for instant insights and deep data explorations.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes the Workflow Studio operations page?

options.text: Application that enables sharing of information in knowledge bases
Single design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, integrations
Usage dashboard and execution details for running and completed workflows
Displays and configures connections for Integration Hub spokes

explanation.correct: The Workflow Studio operations page shows a usage dashboard and execution details for workflow components that are running or have finished running. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes the Knowledge Management application, which lets people share information in knowledge bases. It is not a Workflow Studio page.
This describes Workflow Studio as a whole: one design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations. It does not describe the operations page.
This describes the Workflow Studio integrations page, which shows and configures Integration Hub spoke connections.

questions.quote: The Workflow Studio operations page displays a usage dashboard and execution details for the workflow components that are currently running and have completed running.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes the Workflow Studio integrations page?

options.text: Usage dashboard and execution details for running and completed workflows
Single design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, integrations
Displays and configures connections for Integration Hub spokes
Application that enables sharing of information in knowledge bases

explanation.correct: The Workflow Studio integrations page shows connection details for Integration Hub spokes. You can also use it to configure inbound and outbound spoke connections. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes the Workflow Studio operations page, not the integrations page.
This describes Workflow Studio as a whole, the single design environment. It does not describe the integrations page.
This describes the Knowledge Management application, which is unrelated to Integration Hub spokes.

questions.quote: The Workflow Studio integrations page displays connection details for Integration Hub spokes. You can use this page to configure inbound and outbound spoke connections.

questions.stem: In the Service Catalog, what does a variable type define?

options.text: Single catalog request that can generate several ordered items
Kind of catalog question, such as Single-line text, Select Box, Multiple Choice
Single design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, integrations
Application that enables sharing of information in knowledge bases

explanation.correct: A variable type is the kind of question a catalog variable presents, such as Single-line text, Select Box or Multiple Choice. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-catalog/catalog-builder.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes a service catalog order guide, which lets a single request generate several ordered items.
This describes Workflow Studio, which brings playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations into one design environment.
This describes the Knowledge Management application, which lets users share information in knowledge bases.

questions.quote: This is the Single-line text variable type in ServiceNow AI Platform. ... This is the Select Box variable type in ServiceNow AI Platform. ... This is the Multiple Choice variable type in ServiceNow AI Platform.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes Visual Task Boards (VTB)?

options.text: A plugin that must be activated before it can be installed
AI companion for instant insights and deep data explorations
Turns list and form navigation into an interactive graphical experience
Constructs a condition statement from contextually generated fields

explanation.correct: Visual Task Boards (VTB) transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/visual-task-boards/c_VisualTaskBoards.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes an inactive plugin in the Application Manager dependency list, not Visual Task Boards.
This describes AI Data Explorer, an AI companion for instant insights and deep data explorations, not Visual Task Boards.
This describes the condition builder, which constructs condition statements from contextually generated fields, not Visual Task Boards.

questions.quote: Visual Task Boards (VTB) transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes a data source in ServiceNow import sets?

options.text: Import data from various data sources and map it into ServiceNow tables
Information about internal processing during an import operation
A record that defines what data an import set should import
Status information about individual import operations

explanation.correct: A data source is a record that you create to define what data an import set should import. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportDataUsingImportSets.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes import sets as a whole: they let administrators import data from various data sources and map it into ServiceNow tables.
This describes the import log, which records the internal processing that occurs during an import operation.
This describes the import run history, which gives status information about individual import operations.

questions.quote: Create a data source record to define what data an import set should import.

questions.stem: Which statement best describes Workflow Studio?

options.text: Displays and configures connections for Integration Hub spokes
Usage dashboard and execution details for running and completed workflows
Application that enables sharing of information in knowledge bases
Single design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, integrations

explanation.correct: Workflow Studio brings playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations together in one design environment. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This describes only the Workflow Studio integrations page, which shows and configures Integration Hub spoke connections. It does not describe Workflow Studio as a whole.
This describes only the Workflow Studio operations page, which shows usage and execution details for workflows. It does not describe Workflow Studio as a whole.
This describes the Knowledge Management application, not Workflow Studio.

questions.quote: Consolidate playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, and integrations into one design environment.

questions.stem: In ServiceNow access control, which term refers to the target to which access needs to be controlled?

explanation.correct: In an ACL, the object is the target to which access needs to be controlled, such as a table or field. The ACL rule secures operations against that object. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Applies-to field determines whether an ACL applies to specific records. It narrows the ACL's scope but is not the target being secured.
personalize_choices is an ACL operation. It controls whether a user can right-click a list field and select Configure Choices. It is an operation, not the target of access control.
The post-query ACL check is the step where the instance checks each returned record, evaluating the role, condition and script. It is part of evaluation, not the object being secured.

questions.quote: The object is the target to which access needs to be controlled.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow offering is a suite of products and features that gives users support and critical information at the anticipated time of need?

explanation.correct: Adoption Services is a suite of solutions, both products and features, that gives users support and critical information at the anticipated time of need. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/adoption-services.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Configurable Workspace UI is a focused work area of tools for resolving issues, not a suite of user-adoption support solutions.
Dynamic Guidance is a single proactive AI assistant that generates step-by-step guidance. It is not itself a suite of products and features.
The Content Management System lets users create a custom interface for the platform and its applications. It is not a user-support suite.

questions.quote: Adoption Services is a suite of solutions, both products and features, that provide user support and critical information at the anticipated time of need.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow interface provides a suite of tools in a single, focused work area to help agents answer customer questions and resolve issues?

explanation.correct: The Configurable Workspace UI provides a suite of tools in a single, focused work area to help you answer customer questions and resolve issues. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/workspace-landing-page.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Dynamic Guidance is a proactive AI assistant that gives real-time, step-by-step voice and text guidance. It is not a focused work area for resolving issues.
Unified Navigation lets you access content across your instance in a single pane. It is a navigation experience, not a work area for resolving issues.
CMS integration points use content blocks to link applications together using static and dynamic methods. They are not an agent work area.

questions.quote: The Configurable Workspace UI provides a suite of tools in a single, focused work area to help you answer customer questions and resolve issues.

questions.stem: During a data import, which record determines how the fields in an import set table relate to the fields in an existing ServiceNow table, such as Incident or User?

explanation.correct: A transform map determines the relationships between the fields in an import set table and the fields in an existing target table. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportSetsKeyConcepts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Import run history gives status information about individual import operations. It does not define field relationships.
A data source defines what data an import set should import, not how the fields map to the target table.
The import log records the internal processing that happens during an import. It does not define field mappings.

questions.quote: A transform map determines the relationships between fields displaying in an import set table and fields in an existing ServiceNow table, such as the Incidents or Users table.

questions.stem: An administrator wants details about the internal processing that took place during an import operation. Where should they look?

explanation.correct: The import log is where you find information about the internal processing that occurs during an import operation. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportDataUsingImportSets.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Import run history gives status information about individual import operations, not details of their internal processing.
A transform map defines how import set fields relate to target table fields. It does not log processing.
A data source defines what data an import set should import. It does not record processing details.

questions.quote: The import log is where you can find information about the internal processing that occurs during an import operation.

questions.stem: Which import capability separates the transform and processing functions, giving a more flexible alternative to transform maps?

explanation.correct: Robust import set transformers separate the transform and processing functions, which makes them a more flexible alternative to transform maps. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportSetsKeyConcepts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: A foreign record insert happens when an import changes a table other than its target table. It is not an alternative transform mechanism.
A data source defines what data an import set should import. It does not replace transform maps.
Transformation is converting import set data into another table using the rules in a transform map, so it relies on transform maps rather than replacing them.

questions.quote: Separate the transform and processing functions, providing a more flexible alternative to transform maps.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow term describes JavaScript that runs in the web browser when events occur, such as a form loading, a form being submitted, or a field changing value?

explanation.correct: Client scripts let the system run JavaScript on the client (the web browser) when client-based events occur, such as a form loading, a form submission, or a field value change. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/api-reference/scripts/client-scripts.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: An update set is a group of configuration changes that can be moved from one instance to another. It is not browser-side JavaScript.
A global business rule is a business rule whose Table field is set to Global. Business rules run on the server, not in the browser.
Server scripts run on the server or database, not in the web browser.

questions.quote: Client scripts allow the system to run JavaScript on the client (web browser) when client-based events occur, such as when a form loads, after form submission, or when a field changes value.

questions.stem: In access control, which item controls whether users can update records directly from a list?

explanation.correct: The list_edit ACL operation controls list editing. When it is not granted, the user can't update records (rows) from a list. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Allow-If is an ACL decision type that allows access to a resource if its conditions pass. It is not an operation tied to list editing.
The ACL object is the target whose access is being controlled. It does not specify the list-edit action.
The Applies-to field determines whether an ACL applies to specific records. It does not control updating records from a list.

questions.quote: User can’t update records \(rows\) from a list.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow feature is a proactive AI assistant that provides real-time, step-by-step guidance using voice and text?

explanation.correct: Dynamic Guidance is the proactive AI assistant, invoked from the Help Center and the ServiceNow Otto panel, that generates voice- and text-based, step-by-step, real-time guidance across platforms. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/dynamic-guidance.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Domain separation separates data, processes, and administrative tasks into logical groupings called domains; it is not a guidance assistant.
The Content Management System (CMS) lets users create a custom interface for the ServiceNow platform and applications; it does not provide AI guidance.
Adoption Services is the broader suite of products and features that provide user support at the anticipated time of need, not the specific AI assistant described.

questions.quote: Dynamic Guidance is the proactive AI assistant invoked from Help Center and ServiceNow Otto panel that generates an engaging voice and text based, step by step, real-time guidance, dynamically, across platforms.

questions.stem: Which part of ServiceNow displays a usage dashboard and execution details for workflow components that are currently running or have completed running?

explanation.correct: The Workflow Studio operations page displays a usage dashboard and execution details for the workflow components that are currently running and have completed running. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Knowledge Management (KM) enables the sharing of information in knowledge bases; it does not show workflow execution details.
The Workflow Studio integrations page displays and configures connections for Integration Hub spokes, not workflow execution details.

Workflow Studio is the overall design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, and integrations; the specific page with the usage dashboard and execution details is the operations page.

questions.quote: The Workflow Studio operations page displays a usage dashboard and execution details for the workflow components that are currently running and have completed running.

questions.stem: Which Workflow Studio page displays connection details for Integration Hub spokes and lets you configure inbound and outbound spoke connections?

explanation.correct: The Workflow Studio integrations page shows connection details for Integration Hub spokes. You can also use it to configure inbound and outbound spoke connections. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Knowledge Management is the application for sharing information in knowledge bases. It has nothing to do with spoke connections.
Workflow Studio is the overall design environment for playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations. The specific page that manages spoke connections is the integrations page.
The operations page shows a usage dashboard and execution details for running and completed workflows. It does not show spoke connections.

questions.quote: The Workflow Studio integrations page displays connection details for Integration Hub spokes. You can use this page to configure inbound and outbound spoke connections.

questions.stem: After a user updates a record, which part of the ServiceNow platform determines where that user is redirected?

explanation.correct: The navigation stack is the part of the platform that determines where a user is sent after a record is updated. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/p_NavigationAndUIConfiguration.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Configurable Workspace UI is a single, focused work area of tools for resolving issues. It does not control post-update redirection.
A System Only user preference record is a preference whose value the system sets and updates. It has nothing to do with redirection after an update.
A view defines which elements appear when a user opens a form or list, not where the user goes after saving a record.

questions.quote: The navigation stack is the portion of the ServiceNow suite of applications that determines where a user is redirected after the update of a record.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow application enables users to create a custom interface for the ServiceNow platform and ServiceNow applications?

explanation.correct: The Content Management System (CMS) is a ServiceNow application that lets users create a custom interface for the ServiceNow platform and ServiceNow applications. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/content-management-system/c_ContentManagementSystem.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: CMS integration points are content blocks within CMS that link applications together. They are a part of CMS, not the application that builds custom interfaces.
A view defines which elements appear when a user opens a form or list. It does not create a custom interface for the platform.
Adoption Services is a suite of solutions that provide user support and critical information at the anticipated time of need. It is not an interface-building application.

questions.quote: The Content Management System \(CMS\) is a ServiceNow application that enables users to create a custom interface for the ServiceNow platform and ServiceNow applications.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow feature transforms the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience?

explanation.correct: Visual Task Boards (VTB) transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/visual-task-boards/c_VisualTaskBoards.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The pre-query ACL check is a security step that checks field ACLs using the user's roles before a query runs.
A condition builder constructs a condition statement from a series of contextually generated fields.
AI Data Explorer is an AI companion for instant insights and deep data explorations, not a graphical way to navigate lists and forms.

questions.quote: Visual Task Boards (VTB) transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience.

questions.stem: In access control, which item grants access to a resource when its conditions are passed?

explanation.correct: The Allow-If decision type allows access to a resource if the ACL's conditions pass. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Deny-Unless works the other way. It restricts access by explicitly denying it unless the conditions pass, and it does not itself grant access.
The Applies-to field determines whether an ACL applies to specific records. It is not a decision type that grants access.
list_edit is an ACL operation that controls updating records from a list. It is not a decision type.

questions.quote: |Allow-If|Allow access to resource if conditions are passed.|

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow feature brings playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations together in a single design environment?

explanation.correct: Workflow Studio brings playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables and integrations together in one design environment. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/workflow-studio/workflow-studio.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Workflow Studio integrations page is one page inside Workflow Studio. It shows and configures Integration Hub spoke connections and is not the full design environment.
Knowledge Management lets people share information in knowledge bases. It is not a design environment for workflow components.
The Workflow Studio operations page shows usage and execution details for workflows. It is a monitoring view, not the design environment.

questions.quote: Consolidate playbooks, flows, actions, decision tables, and integrations into one design environment.

questions.stem: In the Next Experience UI, which feature lets users reach content from across the instance in a single pane?

explanation.correct: Unified Navigation lets you access content across your instance in a single pane. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/next-experience-ui.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The navigation stack determines where a user is redirected after updating a record. It does not give access to content across the instance.
Contextual navigation shows you where you are while you work, rather than giving single-pane access to content across the instance.
The Configurable Workspace UI is a focused work area of tools for resolving issues, not the instance-wide navigation pane.

questions.quote: Unified Navigation enables you to access content across your instance in a single pane

questions.stem: An administrator changes the glide.sm.default_mode system property. Which platform behavior does this affect?

options.text: Enables or disables keyboard shortcuts universally
Whether users can access objects matching only wild-card table ACLs
Whether the list editor is available for editing fields in a list
Keyboard shortcut that toggles the application navigator

explanation.correct: glide.sm.default_mode is the Security manager default behavior property. It determines whether users can access objects that match only wild-card table ACLs. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Keyboard shortcuts are enabled or disabled universally through the glide.ui.keyboard.shorcuts.enabled user preference, not glide.sm.default_mode.
Whether the list editor is available is controlled by the list_edit_enable user preference.
The shortcut that toggles the application navigator is defined by glide.ui.keyboard.shortcuts.navigator_toggle.

questions.quote: The Security manager default behavior \(glide.sm.default\_mode\) property determines whether users can access objects that only match against wild-card table ACLs.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to control which dashboard a user sees when first logging in to the instance. Which user preference determines this?

explanation.correct: The homepage preference indicates which dashboard appears when a user first logs in to the instance or clicks the homepage icon. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/r_UserPreferenceSettings.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: glide.ui.keyboard.shortcuts.impersonator defines the keyboard shortcut that opens the impersonator window. It does not affect the landing dashboard.
list_edit_enable indicates whether the list editor is available for editing fields directly in a list. It does not control the dashboard shown at login.
glide.ui.keyboard.shortcuts.navigator_toggle defines the keyboard shortcut that toggles the application navigator open or closed. It does not control the dashboard shown at login.

questions.quote: Indicates which dashboard appears when a user first logs in to the instance or clicks the homepage icon

questions.stem: An administrator needs to control whether users can access objects that match only wild-card table ACLs. Which system property should they adjust?

explanation.correct: The Security manager default behavior property, glide.sm.default_mode, determines whether users can access objects that match only wild-card table ACLs. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: glide.ui.keyboard.shortcuts.impersonator defines the keyboard shortcut that opens the impersonator window. It does not affect ACL evaluation.
glide.ui.breadcrumb_max_entries sets the maximum number of items shown in the breadcrumb. The default is 10.
list_edit_double is a user preference that sets which action opens the list editor in List v2.

questions.quote: The Security manager default behavior \(glide.sm.default\_mode\) property determines whether users can access objects that only match against wild-card table ACLs.

questions.stem: When importing data with import sets, what does a field map do?

options.text: Creates a new record in the target table
Matching table-level and field-level ACLs must both evaluate true
At least one is required to import into a production table
Links an import set table field to a target table field

explanation.correct: Field maps link a field in an import set table to a field in the target table. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_ImportDataUsingImportSets.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Creating a new record in the target table is what happens when coalescing finds no matching record. It is not what a field map does.
The rule that matching table-level and field-level ACLs must both evaluate to true applies to record ACLs, not to import set field maps.
This describes a transform map: every import into a production table requires at least one transform map associated with the import set.

questions.quote: Field maps establish a relationship between a field in an import set table and a field in the target table.

questions.stem: Which of the following has no access to the previous version of a record?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that asynchronous business rules do not have access to the previous version of a record. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/build-workflows/business-rules-classic/c_BusinessRules.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Order field only sets the sequence in which multiple business rules run, from lowest to highest; it has nothing to do with access to the previous record version.
What the docs say about API calls run with setWorkflow(false) is that business rules ignore them, not anything about previous record values.
The docs say query business rules are typically used with the Before option; they are not described as lacking access to the previous record version.

questions.quote: Asynchronous business rules do not have access to the previous version of a record.

questions.stem: Which role allows a user to view and debug access control lists without elevating privileges?

explanation.correct: According to the documentation, normal admin users can view and debug access control lists. Elevated privileges are needed only to create or update them. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: now.assist.creator is a generative AI role used to create flows with Now Assist. It has nothing to do with viewing ACLs.
security_admin is the elevated role needed to create or update ACLs. Viewing and debugging them only requires the normal admin role, with no elevation.
image_admin allows uploading and storing images in the database, not viewing or debugging ACLs.

questions.quote: Normal admin users can view and debug access control lists.

questions.stem: Which role must an administrator elevate to in order to create or update access control lists?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that to create or update existing access control lists, administrators must elevate privileges to the security_admin role. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: image_admin allows uploading and storing images in the database. It does not grant the right to change ACLs.
now.assist.creator is required to create flows with Now Assist, not to create or update ACLs.
personalize_form allows showing or hiding fields with the form designer. It does not allow changing ACLs.

questions.quote: to create or update existing access control lists, administrators must elevate privileges to the security\_admin role.

questions.stem: A team lead asks an administrator to give a colleague the ability to generate a schema map. Which role should the administrator assign?

explanation.correct: The documentation for generating a schema map, which shows different parts of the database schema, lists admin as the required role. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/t_GenerateASchemaMap.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: security_admin is the elevated role administrators need to create or update access control lists. It is not the role listed for generating a schema map.
image_admin lets users upload and store images in the database. It does not grant the ability to generate a schema map.
personalize_form is the role required to show or hide fields with the form designer, not to generate a schema map.

questions.quote:
Generate a schema map to view different parts of the database schema.

## Before you begin

Role required: admin

questions.stem: An administrator needs to perform in-depth data exploration on Performance Analytics indicators and compare scores against benchmarks. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: The documentation says to use the Analytics Hub to perform in-depth data exploration, examine activity over time, and compare scores versus benchmarks. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Signals alerts you to significant changes in KPI indicators; it is not the tool for in-depth exploration and benchmark comparison.
AI Data Explorer is for exploring data alone or with a group using visualizations, AI summaries and conversations. The docs do not describe it as comparing scores against benchmarks.
Automation Discovery identifies workflow automation opportunities; it is not an indicator analysis tool.

questions.quote: Use the Analytics Hub to perform in-depth data exploration, examine activity over time, compare scores versus benchmarks

questions.stem: An administrator needs to design a Performance Analytics solution. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that you design your Performance Analytics solution with KPI Composer. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Signals alerts you to significant changes in KPI indicators; it is not used to design a solution.
KPI Details is used to explore indicators of process behavior, not to design the Performance Analytics solution.
Automation Discovery identifies workflow automation opportunities and is unrelated to designing Performance Analytics.

questions.quote: Design your Performance Analytics solution with KPI Composer

questions.stem: A team wants to investigate data together in Platform Analytics and get not only data visualizations but also summaries and conversations. Which feature should they use?

explanation.correct: You can explore data on your own or with a collaborative group in AI Data Explorer, where you get data visualizations along with summaries and conversations. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Details is for exploring indicators of process behavior, not collaborative data exploration with summaries and conversations.
KPI Signals alerts you to significant changes in KPI indicators. It is not a collaborative exploration space.
Usage Insights provides dashboard-based analytics on user engagement with mobile and web applications. It is not a collaborative, conversational data exploration tool.

questions.quote: Explore data on your own or with a collaborative group in AI Data Explorer, where you can have not only data visualizations but summaries and conversations.

questions.stem: A process owner wants to analyze user engagement with mobile and web applications, including user retention. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: Usage Insights provides dashboard-based analytics on the usage of ServiceNow applications, giving administrators information on user engagement with mobile and web applications, including user population, retention, and behavior. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Signals alert you to significant changes in KPI indicators; they do not analyze application engagement or retention.
KPI Details is for exploring indicators of process behavior, not user engagement with applications.
Process Mining is for finding bottlenecks and deviations in workflows, not analyzing application usage.

questions.quote:
Usage Insights

Learn about dashboard-based analytics on the usage of several ServiceNow applications. Administrators can get information on user engagement with both mobile and web applications, including user population, retention, and behavior.

questions.stem: A process owner wants to help new users get familiar with the ServiceNow AI Platform. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that you help users get familiar with the ServiceNow AI Platform by using the Onboarding Experience. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/c_NavigationAndTheUserInterface.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Portal is described as the way to customize catalogs at any developer skill level, not as a way to familiarize users with the platform.
The All menu retrieves the menu items and modules you can access and lets you favorite and revisit them; it is not an onboarding feature.
Sidebar makes certain Connect Chat functions available in Next Experience; it does not onboard users to the platform.

questions.quote: Help users get familiar with the ServiceNow AI Platform using the Onboarding Experience

questions.stem: A process owner needs to go through the initial configuration of a newly installed application. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: Guided setup is used to go through the initial configuration of any product or application that provides a Guided Setup module. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/adoption-services/adoption-services.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: In-product help gives users contextual information about what they can do on a configurable workspace or UI page. It does not walk through initial configuration.
Guided tours provide step-by-step walkthroughs of applications within your instance for users. They are not for completing an application's initial configuration.
Onboarding modals introduce users to new experiences, products, and applications. They do not configure the application.

questions.quote: Use guided setup to go through the initial configuration of any product or application that provides a Guided Setup module.

questions.stem: A process owner needs to track how long tasks have been open to ensure they are completed within an allotted time. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: Service level agreements can track the amount of time that a task has been open, to ensure that tasks are completed within an allotted time. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_TaskTable.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Time Card Management lets assignees report and track the time they spend on tasks; it does not enforce completion within an allotted time.
The Task Interceptor is where you choose which task child table to create a new record in; it has no role in tracking completion time.
Assignment rules automatically assign tasks to users or groups; they do not track how long a task has been open.

questions.quote: Service level agreements can track the amount of time that a task has been open, to ensure that tasks are completed within an allotted time.

questions.stem: An administrator needs to find bottlenecks and deviations in workflows. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: Process Mining helps you discover ways to streamline your business, find bottlenecks and deviations in workflows, and filter and compare processes. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Signals alert you to significant changes in KPI indicators rather than analyzing workflow bottlenecks and deviations.
KPI Details is for exploring indicators of process behavior, not for discovering workflow bottlenecks and deviations.
AI Data Explorer is for exploring data alone or collaboratively with AI summaries and conversations, not for mining workflow deviations.

questions.quote:
Process Mining

Discover ways to streamline your business, find bottlenecks and deviations in workflows, filter and compare processes, and more.

questions.stem: A process owner wants users to be notified when tasks have been left untouched for a predefined period of time. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: Inactivity monitors ensure that tasks do not fall by the wayside by notifying users when tasks have been untouched for a predefined period of time. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_TaskTable.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service level agreements track how long a task has been open to make sure it is completed within an allotted time. They are not described as detecting tasks that nobody has touched.
Time Card Management lets task assignees report and track their time on assigned tasks; it does not notify users about inactive tasks.
Assignment rules automatically assign tasks to users or groups; they do not monitor tasks for inactivity.

questions.quote: Inactivity monitors ensure that tasks do not fall by the wayside by notifying users when tasks have been untouched for a predefined period of time.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to delegate the creation and maintenance of catalog items to other users. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: The Catalog Builder experience enables you to delegate the creation and maintenance of catalog items. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-catalog/exploring-service-catalog.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Flows automate repeatable multi-step processes; they are not the experience for delegating catalog item authoring.
A playbook is for process automation that needs manual user interaction, such as checklists, not for delegating catalog item creation.
Multiple service catalogs let you target catalog offerings to specific audiences; they do not delegate the creation and maintenance of items.

questions.quote: The Catalog Builder experience enables you to delegate the creation and maintenance of catalog items.

questions.stem: A process owner wants users of Next Experience to see where they are in the instance and to favorite the current item. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: In Next Experience Unified Navigation, the Contextual app pill lets you see where you are in the instance and favorite the current item if desired. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/next-experience-ui.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: All menus retrieves the menu items and modules you can access, lets you favorite them and return to previously visited items; it does not show where you currently are in the instance.
The User menu is for personalizing your instance and setting user preferences, not for showing your current location.
Service Portal is used to build and customize portal and catalog experiences; it is not a Unified Navigation tool for showing your current location.

questions.quote: **Contextual app pill**: See where you are in the instance and favorite the current item if desired.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to create reusable subject line and message body content for email notifications. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: Email templates enable administrators to create reusable content for the subject line and message body of email notifications. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/c_EmailNotifications.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Inbound email actions control how the instance processes incoming email, not the content of outgoing notifications.
Email digests reduce the number of notifications received when records are updated frequently in a short period; they do not provide reusable content.
Notification categories group related notifications in users' notification settings; they do not define subject or body content.

questions.quote: Email templates enable administrators to create reusable content for the subject line and message body of email notifications.

questions.stem: An expert developer needs to write scripts to power a portal. Which ServiceNow tool should they use?

explanation.correct: Expert users can use the Widget Editor tool to write scripts to power a portal. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/service-portal/c_ServicePortal.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Context-sensitive help is used to set a base URL for an external help system, not to script portals.
Branding Editor is for less technical users making basic UI configuration changes to a portal, not for writing scripts.
Service Portal is the overall framework for building a mobile-friendly self-service portal; the specific tool for writing portal scripts is the Widget Editor.

questions.quote: Expert users can use the Widget Editor tool to write scripts to power a portal

questions.stem: A manager using Platform Analytics wants to be alerted to significant changes in KPI indicators. Which ServiceNow feature best meets this requirement?

explanation.correct: The documentation states that you can be alerted to significant changes in indicators through KPI Signals. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/now-intelligence/c_performanceAnalyticsAndReporting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Details is for exploring indicators of process behavior, not for alerting on significant changes.
Task Mining collects and analyzes workstation activities to understand how tasks are performed; it does not alert on KPI changes.
AI Data Explorer is for exploring data with visualizations, summaries and conversations, not for KPI change alerts.

questions.quote: be alerted to significant changes in these indicators through KPI Signals

questions.stem: An administrator wants to run business logic, such as calculations, once at the end of an import instead of on every record. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: The documentation recommends an onComplete transform script for running business logic such as calculations at the end of an import, rather than on each record as business rules do. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_TroubleshootImportSetPerformance.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: CMDB Data Manager performs bulk CI life cycle operations such as deletion and archival. It does not run logic at the end of an import.
A source script computes a single field map's source value from multiple fields, so it runs per record, not once at the end of the import.
Security Tasks Manager is where all security tasks on the instance are visible. It has no role in import processing.

questions.quote: Consider using an onComplete transform script to run business logic such as calculations at the end of an import rather than on each record as business rules do.

questions.stem: An administrator needs to run arbitrary JavaScript code on the server. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: According to the documentation, administrators can use the Scripts - Background module to run arbitrary JavaScript code from the server. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/api-reference/scripts/c_ServerScripting.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Workflow Studio is recommended for building new process automation. It is not a way to run ad hoc JavaScript.
The DurationCalculator script include calculates due dates from a duration or schedule. It is not a way to run arbitrary code.
Script includes hold reusable server code that loads only on request. They store code for other scripts to call and do not run arbitrary code on demand.

questions.quote: Administrators can use the Scripts - Background module to run arbitrary JavaScript code from the server.

questions.stem: A process owner wants to detect potential security threats on the ServiceNow instance. Which feature is the best fit?

explanation.correct: Security Center provides the Security Monitoring console, which you use to monitor and detect potential security threats on your instance. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-security/security-center/sec-center-landing.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Security Tasks Manager is where all security tasks on the instance are visible. It is for viewing tasks, not for detecting threats.
An onComplete transform script runs business logic once at the end of an import. It has nothing to do with threat detection.
CMDB Query Builder builds complex infrastructure and service queries against the CMDB. It is not a security monitoring tool.

questions.quote: Monitor and detect potential security threats on your instance using the **Security Monitoring console**.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow feature best addresses a requirement to monitor duplicate CIs, required CI fields, and audits?

explanation.correct: The documentation describes CMDB Health as the feature used to monitor and maintain CMDB health, including duplicate CIs, required CI fields, and audits. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_ITILConfigurationManagement.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: A MID Server may be required for JDBC imports in some network configurations. It does not monitor CMDB data quality.
A source script computes a field map's source value from multiple fields during a transform. It does not monitor CIs.
CMDB Data Manager handles bulk CI life cycle operations such as deletion, archival, and attestation. It is not the tool for monitoring duplicates and required fields.

questions.quote: CMDB Health[Omitted image "bus-management-console.svg"] Alt text:Monitor and maintain CMDB health: duplicate CIs, required CI fields, and audits.

questions.stem: An administrator needs to change how the instance processes incoming email. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: The documentation directs you to Inbound email actions if you want to change how the instance processes incoming email. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/c_EmailNotifications.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Form annotations provide instructions or additional information about fields on a form. They do not process email.
Formatters add information from macros or previously scripted UI elements to a form. They do not process incoming email.
Inactivity monitors notify users when tasks have been untouched for a predefined period. They do not process incoming email.

questions.quote: If you want to change how the instance processes incoming email, see Inbound email actions

questions.stem: An administrator wants to provide users with on-demand knowledge while they work in the platform. Which ServiceNow feature should they use?

explanation.correct: The documentation describes providing users with on-demand knowledge through In-Product Help. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-user-interface/c_NavigationAndTheUserInterface.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The contextual app pill shows where you are in the instance and lets you favorite the current item. It does not deliver on-demand knowledge.
Sidebar is how certain Connect Chat functions are made available in Next Experience. It is not a help or knowledge feature.
Guided setup walks you through the initial configuration of a product or application. It does not provide on-demand knowledge to users.

questions.quote: on-demand knowledge with In-Product Help

questions.stem: An administrator wants new tasks to be routed automatically to the most appropriate users or groups. Which ServiceNow feature should they configure?

explanation.correct: Assignment rules can automatically assign tasks to users or groups, which ensures that the most appropriate team members handle the tasks. See https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_TaskTable.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Email Reply Separators parse the most recent message in an incoming email thread. They do not assign tasks.
Email templates provide reusable subject line and body content for email notifications. They do not assign tasks.
Form Builder is used to configure forms and replaces the deprecated Form Designer. It does not assign tasks.

questions.quote: Assignment rules can automatically assign tasks to users or groups
